provider.name: Lottery.net
provider.policy_note: Automated live extraction is disabled because Lottery.net Terms section 3.1.7 prohibits data mining, harvesting, and extracting. The adapter accepts saved HTML only when the user has a lawful right to use it.

feeds.name: Illinois Lotto
feeds.notes: Annual pages are unpaginated. Current-era rows may also contain Lotto Million 1 and Lotto Million 2 lists; the archive adapter intentionally imports the first, main Lotto list only.
